# Netscape HTTP Cookie File
# https://curl.se/docs/http-cookies.html
# This file was generated by yt-dlp. Edit at your own risk.
#
# HOW TO GET COOKIES:
# 1. Install "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" browser extension
#    - Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/get-cookiestxt-locally/cclelndahbckbenkjhflpdbgdldlbecc
#    - Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/cookies-txt/
# 2. Login to Instagram/TikTok/Twitter in your browser
# 3. Go to the platform website (e.g. instagram.com)
# 4. Click the extension icon → "Export" → save as cookies.txt
# 5. Replace this file with the exported cookies.txt
# 6. Restart worker: docker compose restart worker
#
